current_phase.next_action: No remaining implementation phases. Use the verification log before extending the targeted-notification pattern to other trip entities.

audit_findings.finding: Already populates created_by_user_id and updated_by_user_id on PackingItem. 'Who added' is tracked at the data layer; only the serializer and UI need to surface it.

packing_items.traveler_name is a free-text string with no FK to users. New nullable assigned_to_user_id is required to support targeted notifications while keeping the free-text fallback for non-account names.
Trip serializer eager loads packingItems.updatedBy and only attaches last_edited_by. Needs to also load createdBy + assignedTo and attach added_by + assigned_to + participants.
record() always notifies all participants except the actor. There is no exclusion mechanism, so the adder cannot be removed from the generic broadcast in favor of a targeted notification.

togglePacked emits a single generic packing.toggled event today. Needs to (a) exclude the adder from the broadcast when adder != actor, and (b) send a targeted packing.packed_for_you / packing.unpacked_for_you to the adder.
Inbox serializer reads event_type and summary directly from the notification data, so new event types render without controller changes as long as TripChangedNotification is reused.

decisions_locked_in: Assignee model: nullable assigned_to_user_id FK alongside the existing free-text traveler_name. Linked user takes precedence; traveler_name is the fallback for non-account packers (e.g. 'Mom', 'Kids').

Default assignee on the add form is the current user. The picker exposes every linked-account participant on the trip plus an 'Unassigned' option that re-enables traveler_name as the primary 'for' label.
Notify the adder symmetrically on both pack and unpack. Event types: packing.packed_for_you and packing.unpacked_for_you.
Reuse the existing TripChangedNotification class for the targeted send so NotificationDeepLinkResolver and the inbox UI render the new events without a parallel notification class.
Exclude the adder from the generic packing.toggled broadcast when sending the targeted notification, so the adder never receives both for the same toggle.
Adder-is-actor short-circuit: if the user packing the item is the user who added it, no targeted notification is sent.
In-scope polish: per-assignee progress segments, 'Mine to pack' filter, adder/assignee initials avatars on every row.
Out-of-scope polish (deferred): one-click reassignment from the read-only row, separate packing.reassigned activity event.
